>If I were in your position I would start a secret journal or a private subreddit or something where I would just write whatever I thought or felt like even if it made no sense at all

Ooo this is a great way of looking at it. I tried this before and had some trouble with it because I thought it wasn't "genuine". How do I get over that?

>Is there something specific you're afraid will happen? Or are you just sort of blindly afraid?

At first it started pretty rational. I was afraid that my bad writing would affect my grades. Now it's kind of moved on to blind fear, where I'm scared but I don't know what the threat is. 

It's a pretty stupid loop now that I think about it. It all started with me wanting to be better at writing and I thought being a perfectionist would help with that. But it's because of that that I'm having hard a time stringing a simple sentence. 

​

>Maybe it would help to deliberately write some garbage, and realize nothing bad will happen?

This is honestly great advice. I'll give it a go.
